_: Places that are ONE design: one blueprint, one build, one agent. A row here is the reason two records may sit inside each other's footprint and must be authored together; every member carries `designGroup` pointing back at the row. worldgen.catalogue checks the membership, the liveness and the spread. See world/sources/catalogue/README.md.

groups.loreReason: The rebellion earthworks are cut into the Akaviri siege works: one field of earth, one build.
The library is a room of the Gandranen ruins, not a second site: one blueprint, one build.
The bonded shed is Gideon's quay ward: the city and its waterside ward are one design.
The rootworm station and the gate-side guide camp are districts of Helstrom, built with the city.

The Made Ground is reached through the Lost City after MQ29 (quests 25 §20e); one blueprint, one build (plan 16 §10, item F1) The spread limit equals the Made Ground's boundTo.maxM (100 m): one number for one fact.
The cordon is the line drawn round the supply town and has no existence apart from it.
